name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: Client Operations & Program Management Specialist
summary: Client operations specialist with 15+ years owning end-to-end account relationships for enterprise and SMB clients, translating requirements into configured workflows across CRM, project-management, and automation platforms. Documents and improves processes as a standing practice, and has spent the last two-plus years applying AI-enabled tooling to streamline client operations at scale. Comfortable as the primary point of contact, coordinating engineering, vendors, and cross-functional teams to keep a client program on track across competing priorities.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel (primary) and HubSpot — contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates.
Managed up to 3 concurrent client engagements at peak, coordinating competing priorities and deadlines while personally building and running each client's operational systems.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K–$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, coordinating campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years — a team of 20, later a team of 8 — overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
